description: Owner tour checks that belong to no single venue entry. tools/venue-proposals.py tour-stops appends each one to the checklist of the named stop (a stop code from tools/probes/tour_stops.json).

checks.text: Drive down Monument Avenue: no Space Force One wreckage (wrecked cars, the flipped craft part, body bags). The debris (loc_q302_car_chase_sf1_debris, excluded in research wave 10) sits inside the always-streamed monument_av prefab, so its hidden default is unconfirmed.

Drive past the Red Peaks freeway bus stop near (1340, -816): no parked ambush truck or spike strip on the shoulder. loc_sq017_ambush was excluded in research wave 11; if the props show, add a var_truck=0 / var_spike_trap=0 toggle on #sq017_pr_truck_freeway.
